basics.name: Jordan Sample
basics.label: Senior Product Designer • Design Systems • Prototyping

paragraphs: Product designer who turns messy workflows into calm, consistent interfaces, and builds the shared components that keep them that way.

work.name: Acme Freight
work.description: Acme Freight is a fictional logistics company used for CVCraft demos.

positions.summary: Lead design for shipment tracking across web and mobile.

highlights.text: Launched a shared component library used by 4 product teams, cutting UI review time by a third.
Redesigned shipment tracking, reducing support tickets about delivery status by 20%.
Mentored two junior designers through weekly critique and paired work.

work.name: Example Health Co.
work.description: Example Health Co. is a fictional clinic network used for CVCraft demos.

highlights.text: Designed appointment scheduling used by 300 clinics.
Led an accessibility audit and fixed 120 issues across the patient app.
Ran monthly usability sessions with front-desk staff.
